title: Total cost of the junta learner
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $\delta\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0<\delta\le 1/2$. For any outcome in the support of the learner's run on $f$, the number of random examples is at most its total random-example budget, the number of membership queries is zero, and its local work is at most its total work budget.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
The outcome belongs to the support of the learner's run on the target
